unite_adi: UPPER SECONDARY-YEAR 11 (AFTER PREP)-LEVEL: B2.3 - THEME 6: LIFE IN THE WORLD & CULTURE

bolumler.ogrenmeKanitlari: PERFORMANCE ASSIGNMENT: Students will prepare a project titled ''Myths and Culture'' by focusing on local and national stories and their connection to today’s world. First, they will research a local or national myth such as stories about ancestors, proverbs, or traditional customs. Then, they will create a storyboard or short video that shows the main message of the myth and how it connects to modern life. Finally, they will discuss how these stories influence community traditions, values, and everyday experiences. Creative elements like drawings, photos, or simple animations should be included in their presentation. The assignment will be evaluated by using a rubric scheme, a rating scale, and/or a marking scheme. Öğrenme-Öğretme Yaşantıları
bolumler.temelKabuller: This theme includes the concept of ''life in the world and culture with its components such as the impact of social media, celebrities, and influencers on cultural trends; digital communication and interpersonal relationships; folklore and myths as cultural heritage'' and it is assumed that it could be present in almost all languages, with some exceptions. It is assumed that a student in after prep year 11 of upper secondary school may know what the impact of social media, celebrities, and influencers on cultural trends; digital communication and interpersonal relationships; folklore and myths as cultural heritage mean in their own language as it is known that almost all people who start to learn a new language bring their pre-existing knowledge (in their own language) with them and transfer it to their new language learning context. However, they may not know how to say these things in a foreign language if this has not yet been covered in their existing curriculum. Fortunately, this existing knowledge in their own language can help them recognise, understand, and learn them more easily in a foreign language, in this case English. As they are students in after prep year 11 of an upper secondary school, they are expected to know some basic vocabulary about ''life in the world and culture'' and also some necessary structures in English from the previous themes and/or years. These grammar items and vocabulary are revised during the ''Revision Programme'' at the beginning of the year and they can be used as a basis for learning the new vocabulary and grammatical items in the current theme, so that the new grammatical elements in the current theme can be learnt easily.
bolumler.onDegerlendirme: It is assumed that these students in after prep year 11 of upper secondary school are ready to learn the concept of ''life in the world and culture with its components such as the impact of social media, celebrities, and influencers on cultural trends; digital communication and interpersonal relationships; folklore and myths as cultural heritage'' cognitively, affectively, and socially since it is appropriate to their age and language level. Therefore, a contextual poster or a large picture could be provided for the students to remember and practise the items that they are related and previously learnt so that they can discuss the poster and/ or the picture in pairs and write down what they remember. This session can help them revise all the related vocabulary and grammatical elements that they have already learnt from previous themes or from previous years as a preparatory practice. In this way, their performance can be evaluated in terms of how much they remember and how accurately they use these items to build their competence in the current theme. It can help the teacher decide what to emphasise, revise, and practise in order to facilitate the new vocabulary and grammatical items in the current theme. (Their performance can be evaluated by rubrics, a rating scale, and /or a marking scheme during these practices.).
bolumler.zenginlestirme: Objective: To talk about the impact of social media, celebrities, and influencers on cultural trends; digital communication and interpersonal relationships; folklore and myths as cultural heritage in English by using target vocabulary. Activity 1: Cultural Connections In this activity, students will work in small groups and each group will discuss one of the following topics: the impact of social media, celebrities, and influencers on cultural trends; digital communication and its effects on relationships; or folklore and myths as cultural heritage. During the discussion, students are encouraged to use the target vocabulary and explore questions such as: ''How do influencers create trends? How does digital communication affect real-life relationships? What role does Netiquette play in online communication? How do myths and folklore shape the cultural identity of a community?''. After the discussion, each group prepares a brief summary of their ideas to present to the class. The teacher gives constructive and supportive feedback on the use of language. Students reflect on their thoughts and feelings about the activity.
bolumler.destekleme: Objective: To talk about the impact of social media, celebrities, and influencers on cultural trends in English by using target vocabulary. Activity 1: Complete the Vision: City Life in 2030 Students read a paragraph and categorise target vocabulary into three themes: Social Media and Trends, Digital Communication, or Cultural Heritage. Then students make their own sentences with these target vocabulary words; they read their sentences aloud, then the teacher gives constructive and supportive feedback on the use of language, accuracy and creativity. Students reflect on their thoughts and feelings about the activity.
